query: SELECT empresaSlug, COUNT(*) as qtd, SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total FROM faturamentos WHERE MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 5 AND YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 2026 AND empresaSlug LIKE '%seraphine%' GROUP BY empresaSlug;
